status: exact first-order Wronskian, upward-crossing, and exceptional-zero reduction; three Xi crossing obligations remain open
proof_boundary: This artifact proves the first-order contact Wronskian bound, crossing-margin equivalence, upward-sign identity, exceptional-zero split, and successor-count composition. It does not prove the q>=1 Wronskian theorem, q<1 multiplicity-compatible theorem, finite shoulders, one-sided successor winding, contact exclusion, Lambda<=0, RH, PF-infinity, or a Clay-prize conclusion.

contact.equations: At a full contact, X=-r_[1]/2 and U=-r_[1],x/2.
contact.sufficient_disjunction: For every point in the live layer, prove either |X|>50000*exp(-5L/4) or 2*|W_[1]|>exp(-5L/4)*(100000*|E_[1],x|+200000*L*|E_[1]|).

boundary_crossing.upward_sign: At X=0, E_[1]=iY!=0, an upward zero U>0 is equivalent to W_[1]*Y<0.
boundary_crossing.exceptional_zero: If E_[1]=0 then X=Y=W_[1]=0; a proxy crossing with U>0 is not classified by W_[1]*Y and must be counted separately.

successor_link.crossing_formula: Insert the decomposed N_up on both horizontal edges into kappa_j=N_up(t_j;R_j)-N_up(t_(j+1);R_j)+I_i(V_j), then add the finite shoulder/join intersection cells.
successor_link.one_sided_target: It is enough to prove the resulting oriented count is <1; positive contact degree then forces kappa_j=0.
successor_link.distinction: The absolute Wronskian margin proves boundary nonvanishing. The signed W_[1]*Y counts and exceptional complex-main zeros are additional data needed for the one-sided winding bound.

route_guards.phase_sign: The aggregate phase derivative is not known to have one sign; stored corrected crossings exhibit both signs below the asymptotic L>=50 layer.
route_guards.component_form: The instantaneous component-rate Hermitian form has inertia (1,1,m-2) when rates differ, so it is not positive semidefinite.
route_guards.ordered_speeds: Positive amplitudes and ordered same-sign component speeds admit an exact double-crossing countermodel.
route_guards.finite_diagnostics: Finite sign diagnostics shape the route but neither prove nor disprove the L>=50 heat-coupled theorem.

open_target.frequency_layer: On q=2tL^2>=1 in the live 0<tL<c_*+o(1) layer, prove the first-order Wronskian disjunction and a signed crossing/phase budget including E_[1]=0 exceptional crossings.
open_target.parabolic_layer: Treat q<1 by a multiplicity-compatible Hermite or degree chart; do not demand a fixed phase-speed floor at t=0.
open_target.shoulders: Close bounded L, L_epsilon, vertical connector, and chart-join phase cells separately.

exact.proof_handoff: Use the Wronskian magnitude to certify first-jet separation at real-part crossings, and use the signs of W_[1]*Im(E_[1]) plus the explicit E_[1]=0 count to upper-bound the successor winding. Do not replace this signed arithmetic theorem by phase monotonicity or component-rate ordering.
